originalRegionLines: **ECS decision — deferred by the owner:** Continue the existing scene-independent C# extraction, typed capability declarations and measured array/storage work. [ECS research](docs/research/ecs-assessment.md) is retained as a conditional assessment, not an adopted architecture. Its proposed library comparison and “before consumer migration contracts are frozen” timing are superseded: ECS adoption, framework selection and prototypes are deferred and are not prerequisites of P0-002–035 or any active work order. Do not add an ECS dependency, implementation experiment or rewrite to satisfy this plan. Existing non-ECS engine, reuse, ownership, performance and worker requirements remain mandatory.

**One sequence, stable IDs:** Execute the Order column top to bottom. IDs identify work; they do not imply scheduling order. All original S001–S847 and source anchors remain valid. The execution predecessor imposes serial delivery; technical prerequisites identify actual required contracts/evidence. Dependency sets mean every listed member. Missing engine behavior discovered later reopens P0-035 and requires an explicit engine child before product work resumes; no product-local solver or bypass.
### Mandatory implementation and independent adversarial review

**REQ-14 applies to every work item without a size or documentation exception.** Dispatch each row/child to a fresh dedicated implementation subagent after its prerequisites pass, then dispatch its deliverable to a different independent adversarial review subagent. Code, refactors, fixes, tests, tooling, design, documentation, research, cleanup and verification are all work. The coordinator delegates, supplies context, reconciles reviewed results and reports status; it does not implement the deliverable or replace either subagent. One implementation owner at a time; do not spawn the backlog. This is the owner's explicit authorization and requirement to use these subagents.

1. **Assign and freeze scope.** Record the work ID, implementation agent/session ID, prerequisite evidence, exact allowed files and current source/dirty-diff/artifact identities. The implementer produces the scoped deliverable and its evidence. Design/research rows freeze decisions; implementation rows begin only after those dependencies pass. Missing devices, participants, choices or prerequisites stay incomplete.

2. **Separate the reviewer.** The coordinator supplies the actual diff, source contract, acceptance criteria, standing requirements and raw evidence to a fresh adversarial review subagent that did not author the deliverable or its fixes. Distinct task labels alone are insufficient: record distinct actual agent/session identities. The reviewer independently inspects the current files and requirements, derives expected outcomes and challenges the implementer's claims; self-review and coordinator-only approval cannot close work.

3. **Prove completion and working behavior.** The reviewer independently runs/reproduces every required-now criterion's appropriate checks, including meaningful positive, negative/control and boundary cases. Runtime-affecting scope includes relevant builds, real Chrome/Playwright behavior, lifecycle and performance checks; documentation/design/research scope includes source accuracy, links, preserved scope, dependencies, consistency and implementability. Apply the row's stage: an I row cannot depend on its later U proof, and a document check cannot claim runtime qualification. Final element/release closure still requires every applicable proof.

4. **Investigate second-order impacts.** Build a justified impact matrix from the actual changed contracts and code/docs: direct and transitive callers/consumers, shared state/ownership, serialized/authored content, tests/tooling/builds, lifecycle/resource handling, worker clocks, performance and active documentation as applicable. Record the search/graph/trace method, each reachable impact, expected unchanged invariant or intended change, verification command/recipe, observed result and evidence. Search or a passing local unit test alone cannot establish absence of regressions. Independently challenge related behavior and requirement interactions. A pass requires zero unresolved unintended regressions within this documented, justified scope; unknown coverage, an unexplored reachable impact or unsupported NotApplicable blocks completion. Do not claim an unbounded proof of no effects anywhere.

5. **Retain an independently attributable verdict.** Use docs/verification/ID/review.md (plus its structured record when CHECK-SCHEMA is implemented) for reviewer identity, reviewed source revision and dirty-diff/contract/bundle/artifact hashes, criterion verdicts, impact matrix, exact reviewer-run checks/raw logs, retained failures, findings and disposition. Record final Pass, Fail or Incomplete with reasons; missing/stale evidence never passes. For publication-required work, record a separate nonterminal SnapshotApproval decision as described below; it is not a completed-task verdict. Before closing or publishing, verify the deliverable still matches the reviewed identities. A change to the reviewed scope or its dependencies invalidates affected proof and requires re-review.

6. **Fix and re-review before advancing.** Findings return to the implementation subagent for forward-only fixes; that revised snapshot must pass a separate adversarial review subagent again. A reviewer that authors a deliverable fix becomes an implementer for that change and cannot review it; assign a different independent reviewer. No completion claim or successor work is allowed before the terminal independent Pass. When commit/push/deployment is required, use the two phases below; publication is authorized by snapshot approval, not by a premature completed-task verdict.
**Publication has two explicit phases, with no waiver of release proof:**

- **Snapshot approval:** The independent reviewer verifies every applicable criterion that can be established before publication, including the actual deliverable, working behavior and justified impact scope, with zero unresolved unintended regression. The contract must enumerate publication-dependent criteria by ID and the exact receipts/deployed checks that will satisfy them; only criteria that genuinely require the published artifact may remain pending. Record SnapshotApproval = Approved against exact source/diff/build/artifact hashes. This nonterminal decision authorizes the implementation subagent to commit/push/deploy only that reviewed snapshot. The task's completion verdict remains Incomplete and successors remain blocked. Missing pre-publication proof cannot be reclassified as publication-dependent to evade the gate.

- **Publication verification and terminal verdict:** After publishing the approved snapshot, the independent reviewer verifies required commit/remote revision, served/deployed artifact identities and every publication-dependent criterion, including actual production-origin behavior/performance where required. Only when the complete stage acceptance set passes may the reviewer record final Pass and permit task closure and successor work. A receipt alone cannot substitute for a required deployed behavior check. A publication failure, missing receipt or unavailable deployed check leaves the task Incomplete; a wrong artifact or reproduced regression is Fail. Any changed deliverable or affected dependency invalidates snapshot approval and requires implementation fixes and independent re-review before publishing a replacement. For work without required publication, the reviewer proceeds directly to the full terminal verdict.

**Finite review gate:** The reviewer's terminal verdict and attached review-only evidence are the required independent gate, not a new implementation item requiring endless recursive reviewers. Any change to code, tasks, design, tests, acceptance criteria or other deliverables during review is implementation and must receive a different reviewer's approval. Review-only receipts may append observed publication identity without altering the reviewed deliverable.

**All 4,558 register rows explicitly inherit this pair.** A table cell naming “Fresh agent ID” specifies only the implementation assignment; its mandatory distinct reviewer and both identities/evidence must also be recorded. No table status, old scoped pass, source profile or coordinator sign-off can waive REQ-14. Historical evidence remains unchanged; it does not retroactively certify this new requirement. Reusing a retained historical/scoped Pass for a current dependency or completion gate requires matching independent-review identity, snapshot and impact evidence under REQ-14. Missing proof leaves that current gate Incomplete while the original historical record stays unchanged.

**Product model readiness:** After P0-035, D rows select/configure an already-qualified engine model and cite its contract hash. Their original model/oracle criteria remain required. A missing or different constitutive model, goal mode or capability reopens P0-035 and must complete a new engine child before product implementation; no local substitute.

**Atomic scope:** D freezes one contract; I implements its declared capability; F/U/V proves a named fixture/consumer; CLEAN removes replaced paths; retained S reconciles and publishes its full source scope. Each current catalogue part, baseline fixture binding, IX law, campaign level and level/difficulty group is separately enumerated below. Supported modes/presets have finite named child criteria and individual evidence. Never publish several new named elements as one item. A grouped parent is a closure audit: its D record must enumerate and insert any missing named implementation children before implementation; no scope may disappear behind a representative pass. Dependency/readiness validation rejects a missing child rather than authorizing a large unspecified batch.

**Mandatory forward refactoring:** Replace the current path and update production callers, current authored content, schemas, tests, automation, builds and active docs together. Never add backwards compatibility, shims, old-name aliases, legacy modes, old/new implementation switches, silent substitution, automatic format migration or temporary hacks to keep retired systems working. Obsolete inputs reject explicitly and atomically. Progressive extraction uses one current production path; it never creates a supported fallback. Cleanup is explicit work before cutover and before each delivered increment's final proof. Historical evidence and original task scope remain immutable records, never supported current input.

**Work orders and criteria:** Each row owns docs/work-orders/ID/contract.md and docs/verification/ID/ artifacts to create during execution. D/baseline records contain source/dirty-diff/bundle identity; exact current symbols/files and allowed changes; affected callers/content; execution ownership; enum/typed-ID inventory; units/ranges/modes/finite stores; independent oracles and numeric tolerances; named positive/control/boundary cases; exact commands/UI actions; applicability and artifact filenames. Criterion IDs use ID/A01 onwards. Closed choices and statuses remain enums in tooling; extensible identities remain typed IDs; conversion occurs only at validated boundaries. A design agent may select an explicit original game rule where historical evidence cannot settle a required behavior, but must preserve scope, label the decision, calculate independent goldens and obtain the separate adversarial review subagent's passing verdict before implementation. No thresholds may be fitted to implementation output.

**Evidence and publication:** The paired-subagent gate above is mandatory before completion, successor work or publication. Every criterion records expected/observed value, tolerance, control/attack, artifact and source/bundle/contract hashes. Native passes, screenshots, inventory coverage or 3600 covered ticks do not prove browser behavior, performance or publication. A new element closes only after its build, actual UI proof, cleanup, independent review and individually verified commit/push. A later invalidating change reopens the owning proof and dependent gates. Missing external hardware/participants records the exact prerequisite and retry condition; emulation or elapsed time cannot close the gate.
### Stage-specific gates

A truthful baseline may pass as a measurement while the measured runtime failures remain open. Every row passes its scoped deliverable and required-now criteria; deferred gates retain a named owner. For split product rows, the source outcome is the complete element's contract: I proves Integration, CLEAN proves retirement, U proves ElementProof, and the original S row reviews/publishes the conjunction. An I/CLEAN/U row cannot require a successor to have completed or claim the whole element finished. Enforcing qualification/release rows cannot defer missing mandatory evidence.
| Stage | Required now | Deferred gate owner |
| Baseline | Untouched identity, reproducible workloads, raw results including all failures, independent report check. | Runtime/concurrency/performance: P0-032/P0-034/P0-035. |

| Design | Finite reviewed behavior/model, children/parameters, independent expected results, actual prerequisites and exact verification commands; zero unresolved required choices. | Runtime implementation and proof: named I/F/U/V/S successors. |

| Native | Compile callers; enum/boundary/architecture tests; independent numerical/control/rollback; Release build; current real UI for affected active parts; scoped regression measurements. | New unconnected law UI: its F row. Worker concurrency: P0-032. Existing absolute-budget failures: P0-034. |

| Worker | Actual worker/transport, targeted ordering/failure/lifecycle controls, affected UI, measured copies/latency/memory, no unexplained scoped regression. | All consumers/domains/devices: P0-030–035. Measurement-only work never claims achieved budgets. |

| Optimize | Algorithm/allocation invariant, unchanged accuracy, affected UI proof, matched before/after measurements; claimed gain exceeds frozen noise. | Absolute engine budgets: P0-034. Conditional AOT/SIMD/art trials may close as measured rejection; mandatory architecture cannot. |

| Integration | P0-035 passed; reviewed D contract; compile typed integration/content/assets; native positive/control/boundary and exact serialization; prove regressions for already delivered active parts; measure scoped cost. This row never claims the new element delivered. | This element's named CLEAN, U and original S closure own retirement audit, full new-element UI proof and individual publication. |

| Cleanup | Remove only the declared retired paths/callers/content/tooling/context; zero unsupported aliases/fallbacks; compile affected callers and verify retired-input rejection and clean Release packaging. | Full affected UI requalification belongs to the named following U/V/qualification row; publication belongs to original S/P0-035. Cleanup cannot close an element. |

| ElementProof | P0-035 and this element's I/CLEAN pass; actual Chrome UI positive/control/integration, exact configuration/links/Reset/save, modes, cadence and affected budgets all pass. | Original S closure independently reviews the complete element and verifies individual commit/push before the next element starts. |

| Element | P0-035 passed; reviewed D contract; typed integration/content/assets; native and current-frontier cases; cleanup; UI/Reset/save, incremental/stress budgets and individual publication. | Future-counterparty cases: later endpoint's owner. Final expanded-catalogue audits remain open. |

| Qualify | Every applicable criterion for this named fixture/consumer/workload/device passes on current artifacts; enforce absolute budgets when the row names workload/device/release gates. | Only explicitly separate future scope stays with named owners. Unavailable hardware remains incomplete. |

| Audit | Each source criterion has current passing child evidence; zero orphan requirement or unresolved necessary finding. Runtime fixes return to their implementation owner and reopen affected proof. | S845/S846 dossiers retain only joint publication pending S847. |

| Release | Entire engine scope at P0-035, or final product scope at S847, passes; forward cleanup, clean production deployment, remote revision and independent verdict verified. | No mandatory criterion may remain deferred beyond that release. |

**Budget policy:** A Baseline pass means the untouched measurement is reproducible, including its failures; it is never runtime qualification. Before each Native/Worker/Optimize increment, freeze required-now absolute limits, correctness/allocation invariants, matched controls and non-regression thresholds, plus an identity-bound ledger of existing failures and their P0 owners. New failures, newly crossed applicable absolute limits or statistically established worsening of existing failures block that increment; an unexplained or inconclusive result is Incomplete, not Pass. A relative tolerance never permits crossing an absolute limit. Existing unchanged failures remain open with the named remediation/qualification owner; no inherited failure may be relabelled NotApplicable, excused by an explained regression or hidden behind an average. An allocation/solver increment may pass its scoped invariant without claiming the final tick/frame budget. P0-034 enforces every engine support tier before P0-035 and product work; later changes stay within that envelope. Final measurements repeat after campaign/mobile/art/profile changes. Unspecified tolerances, startup/memory caps and unmeasured tiers never count as passes. All performance rows inherit the [runnable measurement contract](#measurement-contract).
### Connection ownership and proof tools

Enumerate each required case by typed endpoints/variants/modes/ports/domains/materials/channels/states/topology. **The row introducing the last missing prerequisite owns that real-UI case and requalification of older counterparts.** Individual publication requires all cases available at its revision; future cases stay incomplete with their later delivery owner. They are not unsupported, skipped or passed because an endpoint is absent. Final closure still requires every supported/invalid pairing and bounded simultaneous-input combination; native substitutes never replace eventual actual-part UI proof.

CHECK-SCHEMA/GRAPH/METRICS/AGGREGATE must separate coverage, behavior, lifecycle, performance, independent review and publication. Wrong endpoints with matching Run/Reset fail. Missing/stale criteria are incomplete. Duplicate/reordered reliable output and contaminated runs fail. Fabricated Reviewed/Recorded/Pushed flags cannot establish completion. Unknown enum/schema/field/ID values reject. Exit0 means the declared acceptance set passed; exit1 is a violation; exit2 means missing/stale proof. The schema must encode typed implementation/reviewer identities and roles, reviewed snapshot/artifact hashes, independent review verdict, criterion and impact matrices, reviewer-run checks, findings/disposition and re-review links. Record publication dependency per criterion and separate typed SnapshotApproval decisions from final task verdicts; approving a snapshot is never final Pass. Enforce distinct implementer/reviewer identities and immutable reviewed-snapshot binding; a populated Reviewed flag alone is insufficient. Until CHECK-AGGREGATE implements this enforcement, the two subagents must retain and manually verify these same fields; the requirement applies now. Existing tools retain their documented narrower semantics until these tasks are delivered. Preserve original/mutated fixtures and exact verdicts.

D records resolve current commands from project files and tools/Playtest/README.md, tools/Performance/README.md and tools/Coverage/README.md. Starting entry points are Release builds of affected projects, dotnet publish CuriousContraptions.web -c Release, and its diagnostic export with -p:PlaytestDiagnostics=true. Real UI uses the available Chrome/Playwright connector. Verify actual placed configuration and typed links before interpreting behavior; fake-page tests supplement only. Unknown/stale instructions block command qualification.

**Mandatory worker contract corrections:** Animation evaluation follows its worker clock; only Godot property application follows rendered frames. CLEAN-CONTEXT removes conflicting active wording. Replay records include actual command application tick/phase/order. The wire schema preserves full C# integer identities and tests 2^53 boundaries, signed/unsigned maxima, overflow, unknown variants and malformed lengths.

For split product rows, the source outcome is the complete element's contract: I proves Integration, CLEAN proves retirement, U proves ElementProof, and the original S row reviews/publishes the conjunction. An I/CLEAN/U row cannot require a successor to have completed or claim the whole element finished. Enforcing qualification/release rows cannot defer missing mandatory evidence. Full expensive qualification remains at its named enforcing stage; affected checks remain required earlier. An unrelated global failure is recorded separately with its owner and scope justification, never hidden or converted into global currency. Scoped acceptance cannot waive a global audit explicitly required by that task.

**Budget policy:** A Baseline pass means the untouched measurement is reproducible, including its failures; it is never runtime qualification. Before each Native/Worker/Optimize increment, freeze required-now absolute limits, correctness/allocation invariants, matched controls and non-regression thresholds, plus an identity-bound ledger of existing failures and their P0 owners. New failures, newly crossed applicable absolute limits or statistically established worsening of existing failures block that increment; an unexplained or inconclusive result is Incomplete, not Pass. A relative tolerance never permits crossing an absolute limit. Existing unchanged failures remain open with the named remediation/qualification owner; no inherited failure may be relabelled NotApplicable, excused by an explained regression or hidden behind an average. An allocation/solver increment may pass its scoped invariant without claiming the final tick/frame budget. P0-034 enforces every engine support tier before P0-035 and product work; later changes stay within that envelope. Final measurements repeat after campaign/mobile/art/profile changes. Unspecified tolerances, startup/memory caps and unmeasured tiers never count as passes. All performance rows inherit the [runnable measurement contract](#measurement-contract).
### Connection ownership and proof tools

Enumerate each required case by typed endpoints/variants/modes/ports/domains/materials/channels/states/topology. **The row introducing the last missing prerequisite owns that real-UI case and requalification of older counterparts.** Individual publication requires all cases available at its revision; future cases stay incomplete with their later delivery owner. They are not unsupported, skipped or passed because an endpoint is absent. Final closure still requires every supported/invalid pairing and bounded simultaneous-input combination; native substitutes never replace eventual actual-part UI proof.

CHECK-SCHEMA/GRAPH/METRICS/AGGREGATE must separate coverage, behavior, lifecycle, performance, independent review and publication. Wrong endpoints with matching Run/Reset fail. Missing/stale criteria are incomplete. Duplicate/reordered reliable output and contaminated runs fail. Fabricated Reviewed/Recorded/Pushed flags cannot establish completion. Unknown enum/schema/field/ID values reject. Exit0 means the declared acceptance set passed; exit1 is a violation; exit2 means missing/stale proof. The schema must encode typed implementation/reviewer identities and roles, reviewed snapshot/artifact hashes, independent review verdict, criterion and impact matrices, reviewer-run checks, findings/disposition and re-review links. Record publication dependency per criterion and separate typed SnapshotApproval decisions from final task verdicts; approving a snapshot is never final Pass. Enforce distinct implementer/reviewer identities and immutable reviewed-snapshot binding; a populated Reviewed flag alone is insufficient. Until CHECK-AGGREGATE implements this enforcement, the two subagents must retain and manually verify these same fields; the requirement applies now. Existing tools retain their documented narrower semantics until these tasks are delivered. Preserve their actual exit codes/output, including current stale-symbol/artifact failures; this planning policy does not implement a new checker or override results. Independently justified stale evidence is Incomplete in review records, known violations are Fail, and scoped acceptance remains distinct from global inventory/runtime qualification. CHECK-* must support exact referenced snapshot/evidence identity and justified reuse without requiring duplicate packages. Reused historical evidence remains bound to its original immutable snapshot, with a current independent applicability/input-identity decision; a new unrelated HEAD or global diff alone is not stale proof. The current task still binds its own exact current snapshot, and relevant input/criterion/tool/environment changes invalidate affected reuse. Preserve original/mutated fixtures and exact verdicts.

D records resolve current commands from project files and tools/Playtest/README.md, tools/Performance/README.md and tools/Coverage/README.md. Starting entry points are Release builds of affected projects, dotnet publish CuriousContraptions.web -c Release, and its diagnostic export with -p:PlaytestDiagnostics=true. Real UI uses the available Chrome/Playwright connector. Verify actual placed configuration and typed links before interpreting behavior; fake-page tests supplement only. Unknown/stale instructions block command qualification.

**Mandatory worker contract corrections:** Animation evaluation follows its worker clock; only Godot property application follows rendered frames. CLEAN-CONTEXT removes conflicting active wording. Replay records include actual command application tick/phase/order. The wire schema preserves full C# integer identities and tests 2^53 boundaries, signed/unsigned maxima, overflow, unknown variants and malformed lengths.
